mentions.name: Humadroid
mentions.description: This platform helps small businesses with SOC2/ISO27001 compliance using AI-assisted policy generation and guidance. Recently added business continuity and incident tracking features. It is in beta and the team is going through their own SOC2 assessment.
mentions.problem: SOC2/ISO27001 compliance is painful for small businesses, with the consultant route costing $30-50K, which is brutal for startups.
mentions.audience: Small businesses and startups needing SOC2/ISO27001 compliance.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Humadroid - trying to make SOC2/ISO27001 compliance less painful for small businesses. The $30-50K consultant route is brutal for startups, so we're building an AI-assisted platform that helps with policy generation and guidance.

evidence.value: Working on Humadroid - trying to make SOC2/ISO27001 compliance less painful for small businesses. The $30-50K consultant route is brutal for startups, so we're building an AI-assisted platform that helps with policy generation and guidance.
